scope: Post-hoc T2 first600s analysis after V4 outcomes; no fresh V5 claim. All negative arms retained. No participant-specific deployed rule.
reproduction_status: Published scripts are formatting/I-O refactors of the original executed math. Original receipt source hashes are preserved; no new fits were required for export.

pilot.scope: Post-hoc exposed-only diagnosis, not fresh validation; no participant-specific deployed rule.
pilot.feature_bound: Only12 T2 prepared recordings with n_bins<=30000, already exposed V2/V3/V4 first600s.
pilot.historical_bound: Strictly earlier days, original V4 development histories only; last1/3 before label availability.

pilot_plan.selection: last third labeled prefix with2s purge; refit at full budget; final302:600 only afterward

followup.scope: Post-hoc exposed-first600 T2 followup; no fresh claim. Full600 fits are explicitly optimistic diagnostic fits, never deployment candidates.

data_policy: Aggregate metrics, coverage counts, coefficient norms/cosines and artifact hashes; no coefficient values, per-bin labels, predictions or neural arrays.

verified_reproduction.comparison: Exact parsed equality of every scientific field, with named exclusions only
